New Kuwait Fund 460 – Gash Scheme (Kassala):
•	Joint field visit conducted with UNDP, MoPER, Gash Irrigation Department.
•	Most irrigation canals are buried under sand and currently non-functional; the Gash River has also experienced breaches and course changes.
•	For the preparation of BOQs requires a comprehensive technical study, including topographic surveys (coordinates and elevation levels), to accurately define scope and costs and thus survey engineer needs to be contracted.
